tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Every display and menu background. Displays are black glass; nothing sits on a lighter ground.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty bar tracks, unlit keys, the trailing segment of a rail, divider rules between table rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on glass.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, codes and secondary text on glass (5.6:1 on glass).

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Neutral key fill, the middle segment of a header rail, secondary bars. Black text on it.

tokens.name: command
tokens.usage: Function color for command stations: Command chair, Operations, Main Viewer, the ship profile, Ready Room, Conference. Also the default accent at Condition Green.

tokens.name: navigation
tokens.usage: Function color for navigation and sensors: Flight, Science, Intelligence, Electronic Warfare, the situation table. Also the 'ok' status light.

tokens.name: systems
tokens.usage: Function color for ship systems: Engineering, Environment, Damage Control, Communications, Lift, Head. Also the 'warn' status light and the accent at Yellow Alert.

tokens.name: tactical
tokens.usage: Function color for Tactical and Weapons Control. Also the 'alert' status light and the accent at Red Alert. Never decorative.

tokens.name: seam-light
tokens.usage: Room lighting only: wall seams, coves and downlights. Never used on a display.

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: Display padding, as a share of the screen's short side (min 5px).

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Gap between sub-panels, as a share of the content width.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything on a display. Corners are hex-cut, never rounded.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Only the outer edge of a station menu panel.

tokens.name: hex-cut
tokens.usage: A tab's angled end is cut back by 32% of its height (max a third of its width), giving the 60° hex profile used on keys, rails and bars.

tokens.name: node-inner
tokens.usage: The hex node's black core, as a share of its radius.
